Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Type: Lead Acid Battery No. of Cells: 108 Cell Voltage: 2V

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Elsayed Mohamed, eng. Al-Sayed Atia 
 Abdel-Maqsoud, tested by eng. Abdel-Latief Ahmed Shetat, accepted by eng Al-Sayed Atia 
 Abdel-Maqsoud: general director, revised by EDEPC 
 quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar, and approved by eng. 
 Fathe Mahmoud Ragb: Head Sector of Talkha PS.

This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.

Safety 
Precautions

A work 
 permit must be issued and maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
 category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as 
 safety shoes, safety Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses, safety goggles, rubber gloves and rubber 
 apron.
Smoking is prohibited inside the battery room

The battery instructions must be 
 displayed visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in 
 the battery room.

When working in the battery room 
 be aware of parts under voltage.

The battery set is out 
 of service if necessary.

items:
The battery set is out 
 of service if necessary.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Complete set of common keys

Thermometer, 
 and 
 Hydrometer

Digital 
 multimeter.
Work to be Carried Out
Ensure that the cells are clean and dry, external clean the caps.

Check that connections are properly tightened, lubricate them and 
 fully screw them.

Check the temperature of the cells: constantly high temperature 
 will increase the consumption of water and reduce the life of the battery 
 whereas, constantly low temperature will lower discharge performance.
Read and record the voltage, density and temperature of each cell.

Check the electrolyte level and top them up with distilled water if 
 necessary.
Apply an equalizing charge.
Carryout full charge-discharge cycle.
